texts.text: Auctionata Founded: 2012 | 2011 HQ: Berlin Founders: Alexander Zacke, Georg Untersalmberger Website: http://auctionata.com/ Auctionata is the first enterprise ever to enable traditional and authentic auctions on the internet. The Berlin start-up makes the market for art, antiques and collectibles transparent and easily accessible by taking traditional auctions online. Since May 2013, several times per week, Auctionata broadcasts real-time online auctions worldwide. The company also operates an online shop with curated goods, sold at fixed prices. Auctionata holds several world records for the highest prices paid for works of art in an online auction. Representative: Lars Langusch General Partner See all investments supported by Lars

Carmudi Founded: 2013 | 2015 HQ: Berlin Founders: Stefan Haubold, Fritz Simons Website: http://www.carmudi.com/ Carmudi is the vehicle marketplace that offers buyers, sellers and car dealers a platform to find cars, motorcycles and commercial vehicles online. The company is currently active in several Asian countries and Mexico. Representative: Martin Weber General Partner See all investments supported by Martin

Delivery Hero Founded: 2010 | 2010 HQ: Berlin Founders: Niklas Östberg, Fabian Siegel (Lieferheld) Website: http://www.deliveryhero.com/ Delivery Hero is holding company of several internet platforms where customers can order food (e.g. Pizza, Pasta, Asian Food etc.) quickly and securely and at no extra cost. Choice, convenience, reliability, and quality are the key benefits for the customers. Delivery Hero provides a purely success-related lead generation platform for delivery services. Delivery Hero and Lieferheld were merged in February 2012. Lieferheld was founded in September 2010 and is located in Berlin. Representative: Martin Weber General Partner See all investments supported by Martin

If you can photograph it, you can sell it. Users follow their favourite individuals, shops and brands to discover what they buy, sell and like, or open their own little mobile shop with the touch of a button. Combining high-quality food with lightning-speed delivery, the new business goes far and beyond traditional services. For the price of a pizza, EatFirst not only provides the customer with a freshly prepared lunch, but also with lightning-fast delivery, all within 15 minutes of the order being placed. Users pay for their order with a credit or debit card through the app. Representative: Martin Weber General Partner See all investments supported by Martin

eDarling Founded: 2008 | 2009 HQ: Berlin Founders: David Khalil, Lukas Bosseder Website: http://www.edarling.de/ eDarling is one of the leading European online matchmaking services. eDarling addresses demanding singles, who search for a long-lasting relationship. The eDarling relationship questionnaire helps to match people based on important, meaningful dimensions of compatibility. eDarling sets benchmarks for product, matching and service quality. Today, the company has earned the trust of more than 13 million singles, creating on average 2000 couples every month in over 20 countries worldwide. Representative: Martin Weber General Partner See all investments supported by Martin

Experteer offers the widest range of user possibilities, e.g. by supplying top job openings that span the whole spectrum of the job market. Also, customers can discreetly make their career profiles available to head hunters. Representative: Lars Langusch General Partner See all investments supported by Lars

In addition to the online shop, local showrooms market the products and brands to consumers in most major German cities. Kiveda Founded: 2012 | 2012 HQ: Berlin Founders: Julian Strosek, Michael Börnicke Website: http://www.kiveda.de/ Kiveda re-invents the way of shopping kitchens – easy, fast and comfortable. In Germany’s first online shop for kitchens, Kiveda’s customers configure their kitchen online and order it direct from the manufacturer. Offering a first class service and high level of transparency, Kiveda ensures that its customers receive their kitchen according to their requirements fast and easy and at an optimal price-performance-ratio. Through close cooperation with leading logistics and assembly partners Kiveda provides the ideal delivery service. Customers chose whether they want the kitchen to be delivered and installed or just delivered. In December 2014, Kiveda joined forces with Küchen Quelle.
